@opentui/core-darwin-arm64.shipped_evidence: libopentui.dylib (6.3 MB) contains 796 statically-linked FFmpeg symbols and is embedded byte-identically in the built binary at offset 167,016,147 (verified by full-length byte comparison).
@opentui/core-darwin-arm64.decision: Two distribution models were distinguished (LICENSING_DETERMINATION.md). PM-0 (publish the plugin only) redistributes no native code and no FFmpeg. PM-1 (bundle a binary) can ship a libopentui rebuilt from pinned OpenTUI v0.8.4 source WITHOUT FFmpeg: verified to build, load, pass the ABI check and render the TUI, with 796 FFmpeg symbols reduced to 0 genuine ones.
required_actions: ship PM-0 (plugin only) or PM-1 built with --no-ffmpeg; do not ship the stock LGPL binary without counsel
generate and ship THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt from scripts/generate_notices.py for whichever model is used
for PM-1-stock only: nine license files + FFmpeg 9.0.2 source + LGPL-2.1 s6 relinking route (OPENTUI_LIB_PATH, proven)
@opentui/core-darwin-arm64.residual: Legal review of the chosen model is still advisable before public release, but no LGPL obligation attaches to PM-0 or PM-1-no-FFmpeg.
